# FAMILY02 A — successor-visible case facts

Blank, cell, duplicate, and custody checks pass. Turbidity is 150 NTU. Reproducible composition is 21% mineral grains and 46% organic flocs; the remainder is mixed fines. No gravimetric reference is provided.
